title: Barber: one to two craft a year recovered over his range

tellings.quote: public, he would say over his specific range 1 to two a year.

plain: A man named Jake Barber has said in public that one or two unknown craft a year were recovered over the test range where he worked. A commentator who goes by UAPGerb repeats this on the show as Barber's own public claim, saying "over his specific range 1 to two a year." If true, it would mean recoveries of unexplained craft happen often, not once in a lifetime.
